[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Witman's Folly | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=095 }} [[Witman's Folly]] is a relatively small area that is made up snowy terrain and ice blocks that borders a frozen sea to the south. The [[Deldrimor]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] maintain a port to the southwest for their ice ships. The western half of this area has dense populations of [[Grawl]] while the seemingly empty eastern areas are in truth hiding many [[Nightmare]] groups. ==Getting there== Witman's Folly lies southeast of [[Droknar's Forge]] and is usually traversed on the way to [[Port Sledge]] in the southwestern corner of this area. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *West, near the center of the western half of the map. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{mo}} 10 (20) [[Mag Ironwall]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Intricate Grawl Necklace]]s) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Vania Sewell]] (collector for 7 [[Azure Remains]]) ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 (5) [[Black Bear]] ===Foes=== [[Grawl]] *{{w}} 22 (26) [[Grawl (Shiverpeaks)|Grawl]] *{{n}} 22 (26) [[Grawl Crone]] [[Imp]]s *{{e}} 22 (26) [[Ice Imp]] (does not always spawn) [[Nightmare]]s *{{mo}} 22 (26) [[Azure Shadow]] ====Bosses==== Grawl (4 of these 5 Grawl bosses [[spawn]] in any one [[instance]]) *{{w}} 28 (30) [[Sakalo Yawpyawl]] → [["Victory Is Mine!"]] *{{r}} 28 (30) [[Salani Pippip]] → [[Poison Arrow]] *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Ipillo Wupwup]] → [[Unyielding Aura]] *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Karobo Dimdim]] → [[Plague Signet]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Alana Kepkep]] → [[Glimmering Mark]] Imps *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Sniik Hungrymind]] → [[Energy Drain]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Maak Frostfriend]] → [[Mind Freeze]] ==Notes== * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.8% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 100|low = 88|high = 112}} ** Be careful with approaching the Grawl groups as they patrol close to each other. ** Consider clearing the western half first (the Grawl). The only visible groups in the eastern half are the two boss groups. Be careful of hidden Nightmare [[popup]]s when approaching the two boss groups. ** There is a pair of Grawl that can easily be missed as they may travel the length of the path that connects to Droknar's Forge. * Skills can be [[capture]]d faster by repeatedly entering from Port Sledge until the Grawl boss with the desired [[elite skill|elite]] spawns near the portal. * The Grawl here have very few skills and even on hard mode they are easy to interrupt. This combined with their clustered nature makes the Wastrel skills extremely potent here. * Three [[Shiverpeak Chest]]s ([[Locked Chest]]s in [[Hard mode]]) will always spawn in this area, occasionally one of the chests spawns directly outside of [[Droknar's Forge]]. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Whitland Flats}} *Witman's Folly is probably named after [[Marshall Whitman]]. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Witmans Torheit]]
